response.summary: Your request for 20 standard laptops has been approved. The purchase will be processed through vendor V-101.

reasons.statement: Standard laptops are within the price cap and no hardware exception is required.
Stock does not cover the full quantity, so purchase is required.
Vendor V-101 is an approved vendor with the lowest eligible price.

policy_basis.heading: Use existing stock first
policy_basis.text:
Before buying, stock available at the requested office must be used. Available stock
means units on hand minus units already reserved. Only the shortfall may be purchased.

If another office has enough available stock to cover the entire shortfall, the
items must be transferred rather than bought. A partial transfer is not required.

policy_basis.heading: Tax
policy_basis.text:
All approval limits and budget checks use the total including GST. GST is charged at
18% on all goods in this policy unless the purchase order states otherwise.

policy_basis.heading: Approval limits
policy_basis.text:
Approval depends on the order total including GST. Each level includes the approvers
named for that level only.

- Up to ₹50,000: Line Manager.
- ₹50,001 to ₹5,00,000: Department Head.
- ₹5,00,001 to ₹25,00,000: Department Head and Finance Controller.
- Above ₹25,00,000: Department Head, Finance Controller and CFO.

policy_basis.heading: Competitive quotes
policy_basis.text:
The number of quotes required depends on the order total including GST.

- Up to ₹1,00,000: one quote.
- ₹1,00,001 to ₹10,00,000: two quotes.
- Above ₹10,00,000: three quotes.

Quotes must come from vendors with Approved status that serve the delivery office.

If fewer qualifying vendors exist than the number required, the order may proceed as a
sole-source purchase, and the reason must be recorded on the purchase order.

policy_basis.heading: Vendor selection
policy_basis.text:
Among vendors eligible for the order, the lowest price excluding GST must be chosen.
A higher-priced vendor may be chosen only if the lowest-priced vendor cannot meet a
delivery date stated in the request, and the reason must be recorded.

sources.title: IT Hardware Standards
sources.text:
Price caps are per unit, excluding GST.

- Standard (LAP-STD-14): all employees. Cap ₹85,000.
- Engineering (LAP-ENG-16): employees in the Engineering department only. Cap ₹1,40,000.
